bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for the corridors of commerce program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CORRIDORS OF COMMERCE.

$150,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation for the corridors of commerce program under Minnesota Statutes, section 161.088.
additions: $150,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation for the corridors of commerce program under Minnesota Statutes, section 161.088.
